operators.customDisplayName: Load NIFC wildfires data from data/wildfire/input/nifc_wildfires.csv with tab separator and comma thousands separator, yielding Year, Fires, Acres columns
Aggregate NOAA monthly data to annual level by extracting Year from Date (YYYYMM), summing Number of Fires and Acres Burned per year.

operatorProperties.code:
def process(noaa_annual, nifc_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    nifc = nifc_data.copy()
    nifc['Acres'] = nifc['Acres'].str.replace('[,*]', '', regex=True).astype(float)
    nifc = nifc.rename(columns={'Fires': 'nifc_fires', 'Acres': 'nifc_acres'})
    
    merged = noaa_annual.merge(nifc, on='Year')
    
    merged['diff_fires'] = merged['noaa_fires'] - merged['nifc_fires']
    merged['diff_acres'] = merged['noaa_acres'] - merged['nifc_acres']
    
    corr = merged['diff_fires'].corr(merged['diff_acres'])
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'correlation': [round(corr, 3)],
        'n_years': [len(merged)],
        'year_min': [merged['Year'].min()],
        'year_max': [merged['Year'].max()]
    })

operators.customDisplayName: Merge NOAA annual and NIFC data on Year, clean NIFC Acres by removing commas and asterisks, compute diff_fires (noaa_fires - nifc_fires) and diff_acres (noaa_acres - nifc_acres), then compute Pearson correlation between the two differences.
